items.title: Ambuja Cements Q4 net profit surges 37%
items.description: Ambuja Cements announced strong March quarter earnings. Net profit surged over 37 percent year-on-year. This growth was significantly boosted by a substantial tax credit. Sales volume reached an all-time high, alongside record revenue. The company noted ongoing cost pressures from fuel and packaging. These challenges are expected to persist into the first half of FY27.

items.title: Global Earnings | HSBC reports flat first-quarter profit; expects further credit loss
items.description: HSBC Holdings saw flat first-quarter profits. Higher credit loss charges in the UK and provisions for Middle East conflict impacted earnings. The bank anticipates more credit losses this year. This is due to a worsening economic outlook and a significant charge for a UK investment bank exposure. HSBC has revised its credit charge forecast upwards for 2026.

items.title: PNB Q4 Results: Cons net profit jumps 14% YoY to Rs 5,225 crore, but NII down 4%
items.description: Punjab National Bank announced a robust 14% year-on-year net profit surge to Rs 5,225 crore for Q4 FY26, despite a slight dip in net interest income. The bank also recommended a Rs 3 per share dividend. Asset quality showed sequential improvement, with gross NPAs falling to 2.95%.

items.title: M&M Q4 Results: Standalone PAT jumps 53% YoY to Rs 3,737 crore; Rs 33/share dividend declared
items.description: M&M Q4 Results: M&M board also recommended a final dividend of Rs 33 per ordinary equity share of face value Rs 5 each, for FY26. The record date for the final dividend shall be Friday, July 03, 2026.

items.title: Raymond Q4 results: Cons PAT falls 91% YoY to Rs 12 crore despite 8% revenue uptick
items.description: Raymond on Tuesday reported a steep 91% YoY drop in Q4 net profit to Rs 12 crore despite an 8% revenue rise. Sequentially, PAT improved 68%. EBITDA and margins weakened, but FY26 reflected steady growth driven by aerospace, defence, precision technology, and auto components, with management emphasising high-moat, high-margin expansion.

items.title: Voltamp Transformers Q4 Results: Shares crash 20% after weak March quarter numbers. Check details
items.description: Voltamp Transformers shares plunged after weak Q4 FY26 results, with profit halving and margins sharply declining due to one-time provisions, rising input costs, and currency impact. Revenue remained flat, though annual performance showed growth and order backlog stayed strong.

items.title: Marico Q4 Results: Profit rises 14% to Rs 391 crore; co declares Rs 4 dividend
items.description: Marico reported strong March quarter results with 22% revenue growth and 14% profit rise, driven by robust India volumes and international momentum. Margins contracted due to high input costs. Board announced Rs 4 dividend, while full-year growth hit multi-year highs.

items.title: L&T declares Rs 38/share dividend, sets record date on May 22
items.description: Larsen & Toubro announced a Rs 38 dividend for FY26, alongside mixed Q4 results with slight profit decline and strong revenue growth. Robust order inflows and international expansion supported annual performance, positioning the company for future technology-driven growth.

items.title: Coforge Q4 Results: Profit more than doubles to Rs 612 crore on robust deal wins
items.description: Indian IT services provider Coforge fourth-quarter profit more ​than doubled, the firm reported ​on Tuesday, helped by a rise ​in order intake and revenue.

items.title: L&T Q4 Results: Profit falls 3% YoY to Rs 5,326 crore; co declares Rs 38/share dividend
items.description: L&T Q4 Results: Larsen & Toubro reported a 3% YoY decline in Q4 net profit to Rs 5,326 crore, despite an 11% revenue growth to Rs 82,762 crore. The company's order book reached an all-time high of Rs 7.4 lakh crore. L&T is also set to divest stakes in Nabha Power and L&T Metro Rail by June 30.

items.title: Hero MotoCorp posts record profit on strong sales and EV growth
items.description: Hero MotoCorp reported record Q4 and FY26 profits driven by strong sales, premiumisation and EV growth. Revenue and volumes surged, margins improved, and global expansion strengthened, reinforcing its leadership and positioning for sustained future mobility growth.

items.title: Hero MotoCorp posts record profit on strong sales and EV growth
items.description: Hero MotoCorp reported record Q4 and FY26 profits driven by strong sales, premiumisation and EV growth. Revenue and volumes surged, margins improved, and global expansion strengthened, reinforcing its leadership and positioning for sustained future mobility growth.

items.title: J&K Bank profit jumps 36% as asset quality and growth improve
items.description: Jammu & Kashmir Bank reported a 36% rise in Q4 profit with improved asset quality and higher operating profit. Annual profit hit a record high, while advances and deposits grew steadily, supported by focus on retail, MSME and agriculture lending.

items.title: Shoppers Stop reports Q4 net loss of Rs 16.35 cr; FY26 revenue at Rs 5,095 cr
items.description: Retail chain Shoppers Stop on Tuesday reported a consolidated loss of 16.35 crore for the March quarter.

items.title: NSE announces Rs 35 per share dividend, includes Rs 10 special payout
items.description: National Stock Exchange of India announced a Rs 35 dividend for FY26, including a special payout, alongside 8% profit growth and 22% revenue rise. Strong transaction income and EBITDA gains drove performance despite mixed annual income trends.

items.title: Hero MotoCorp Q4 Results: Profit jumps 30% YoY to Rs 1401 crore; Rs 75 per share dividend declared
items.description: Hero MotoCorp Q4 Results: Hero MotoCorp reported record revenue and profit for FY26's fourth quarter, with revenue reaching Rs 12,797 crore and profit after tax at Rs 1,401 crore. The company also achieved its highest-ever annual revenue and profit for FY26, driven by strong sales across segments and growth in its electric mobility and global businesses.

items.title: Poonawalla Fincorp Q4 results: Profit jumps 70% QoQ to Rs 255 crore
items.description: Poonawalla Fincorp reported a sharp profit rise driven by margin expansion, higher income, and improved asset quality. AUM crossed Rs 60,000 crore, credit costs eased, and capital adequacy strengthened after fundraise, supporting future growth and digital expansion.

items.title: Aadhar Housing Finance Q4 profit surges 27% to Rs 311 crore on strong growth and expansion
items.description: Aadhar Housing Finance reported 27% Q4 profit growth to Rs 311 crore, driven by strong loan disbursements and business expansion. Assets under management rose 20%, while asset quality remained stable. The lender targets continued growth with branch expansion plans.

items.title: NSE Q4 Results: Cons PAT grows 8% YoY to Rs 2,871 crore, revenue jumps 32%; Rs 35 per share dividend declared
items.description: NSE Q4 Results: India's leading stock exchange NSE reported a consolidated net profit at Rs 2,871 crore in the March-ended quarter versus Rs 2,650 crore in the year ago period, implying a 8% uptick.

items.title: Quess Corp posts Rs 64-cr profit in Q4
items.description: Staffing and workforce solutions provider Quess Corp has posted a consolidated profit of Rs 64.34 crore during the March quarter.

items.title: SRF Q4 Results: Net profit rises 11% to Rs 582 crore; to invest Rs 2,300 cr on new plant in Odisha
items.description: Chemical firm SRF Ltd on Tuesday reported an 11 per cent increase in its consolidated net profit to Rs 582.02 crore for the quarter ended March and announced plans to invest Rs 2,300 crore to set up a plant in Odisha.
